candidates.change_summary: Replace 'require(msg.value == 10 ether)' with 'require(msg.value == 0 ether)' so that the call succeeds without sending 10 ether, changing the balance and possibly the transfer.

Replace 'require(block.timestamp > pastBlockTime)' with 'require(true)' to remove the timestamp restriction, allowing multiple calls in the same block that can trigger the transfer condition differently.
Replace 'if(block.number % 15 == 0)' with 'if(true)' so the transfer always occurs, changing the balance returned to sender and internal state (balance) surfaced via ETH transfers.
Replace 'if(block.number % 15 == 0)' with 'if(false)' so the transfer never occurs, changing the balance returned to sender and internal state.
Delete the require for msg.value so the fallback accepts any amount, which changes the contract balance and thus the amount transferred under the condition.
Delete the transfer statement so no ETH is ever sent back, changing the observable ETH flow to the caller.
Replace 'pastBlockTime = block.timestamp' with 'pastBlockTime = 0' so the timestamp requirement is never effective, allowing more frequent calls that change transfer behavior.
